airframe: Fighter1, Multirole1, SmallFighter1, trainer, VTOLTrainer1, CAS1, COIN, EW1, FastBomber1, Darkreach
note: HIGH-THROTTLE ARM of the q axis. Geometry, entry condition, altitude, lane list and lane count are byte-identical to 'oblique-6-dwell'; the ONLY differences are the pinned ScenarioThrottle (1.00 instead of the 0.70 default) and repeat 4 instead of 8. See 'oblique-6-dwell-t040' for why the axis exists. THE ONE CAVEAT THIS ARM HAS AND THE LOW ARM DOES NOT: at 1.00 the fast lanes can reach the aero ceiling and stop separating. R37 already had Multirole1 at 2.37x corner = 379 m/s on leg 4 at throttle 0.70, against a 416.7 m/s Vmax. Read spd / sc_infoMaxSpeed per lane: a lane above 0.95 of that is riding its own Vmax and its manipulation is COMPRESSED, not absent -- report it, do not drop it. TAGS carry a t10 suffix so no tool can pool them with the 0.70 anchor's legs; the suffix resolves to oblique_step by prefix.
